comments.body:
" still struggle to pursue higher education bc the selection starts pretty early arouns age 10 to 13 depending on the canton"

What you say makes no sense.  

Going into higher education is not selective in Switzerland. Anybody has two, and maybe even three tries, in EPFL (I dont know about ETH). If you find your level of math or physics or whatever bad, there's millions of resources online, for free, from Harvard or MIT or whatever else you can think of. It's hard because it's hard, not because you're discriminated against, and plenty of people make it even with a non traditional background. 

No need to make yourself a victim.
comments.author: itsleis
